annotations.title: Yield or price calculator for one series

description: What-if calculator for one Catalyst bond series. Give the series code and EITHER a clean price you saw at your broker (price_pct, % of face value, e.g. "101.5") OR a yield (yield_pct, % per year, annual effective) and get: accrued interest, dirty price, yield to maturity (annual effective and compounded per coupon period), current yield, duration for fixed-rate bonds and an approximate effective margin for floating-rate bonds. Uses our coupon terms and the current coupon (for floating-rate bonds the current coupon is assumed to stay until maturity); before tax and fees; early redemption and amortisation are not modelled. We publish no market prices: the price must come from the user. Kalkulator: rentowność z ceny albo cena z rentowności, odsetki narosłe, cena brudna.

code.description: Catalyst code of the series, e.g. "KRU0632".

face_value.description: Optional face value of one bond in its currency (e.g. "100" or "1000") to also get amounts per bond.

price_pct.description: Clean price in % of face value (without accrued interest), as quoted on Catalyst, e.g. "101.5". Give this or yield_pct.

settlement_date.description: Settlement date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today + 2 business days, the Catalyst T+2 rule).

yield_pct.description: Yield to maturity in % per year (annual effective, ACT/365), e.g. "7.2". Give this or price_pct.
